GA4 tracking not installed — no organic traffic data being collected
robots.txt mismatch between live and dist deployment
No HSTS or CSP security headers
Gallery images have useless alt text across all pages

Add GA4 gtag.js snippet to base layout
Replace gallery alt text with descriptive content
Fix month-page OG images to use og-best-time.webp

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Static HTML, fully server-rendered (Astro) — no JS dependency for content
Self-referencing canonical tags on every page
Clean, descriptive hyphenated URLs with consistent trailingSlash: never
robots.txt (dist) correctly allows AI crawlers and references sitemap
llms.txt present and well-structured
404 page uses noindex, follow with functional navigation

findings.title: Live deployment not serving built content
findings.description: yunnanprovince.com returns a 114-byte JS redirect page to /lander — the 33-page travel guide from dist/ is invisible to Googlebot and all crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Deploy dist/ contents to live web server or CDN, replacing the lander redirect.

findings.title: robots.txt mismatch between live and dist
findings.description: Live robots.txt references /sitemap.xml (does not exist); dist references /sitemap-index.xml (correct). The live deployment is out of sync with the build.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the dist version of robots.txt to the live server.

findings.title: GA4 tracking not installed
findings.description: Every page has an HTML comment <!-- Google Analytics 4 --> but no actual gtag.js script or G- measurement ID exists. Zero organic traffic data is being collected.
findings.recommendation: Add Google Tag snippet to src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro with an actual G- measurement ID.

findings.title: Missing HSTS and CSP security headers
findings.description: public/_headers provides X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, and Referrer-Policy, but lacks Strict-Transport-Security and Content-Security-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add HSTS (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains) and CSP headers.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod dates are all identical
findings.description: All 33 URLs in sitemap-0.xml share the same lastmod of 2026-08-07. Google uses lastmod to prioritize re-crawling; identical dates remove that signal.
findings.recommendation: Configure Astro sitemap integration to use actual file modification timestamps.

findings.title: No IndexNow support
findings.description: IndexNow protocol is not implemented, meaning slower indexing on Bing, Yandex, Naver, and Seznam.
findings.recommendation: Add an IndexNow key file and ping endpoint for fast non-Google indexing.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Excellent prose quality with firsthand travel knowledge
Comprehensive destination coverage (8-10 sections per destination)
Consistent content structure across all destination pages
Rich internal linking network between destinations, itineraries, and guides
Clear H1→H2→H3 heading hierarchy with question-based H2s
FAQ section covers high-value travel queries with specific answers

findings.title: No individual author attribution
findings.description: All Article schema uses 'Yunnan Guide Team' — a generic collective byline. Individual author names with credentials strengthen E-E-A-T.
findings.recommendation: Add real author bylines with bio pages and Person schema.

findings.title: No original research or first-party data
findings.description: Content is well-written travel journalism but lacks unique datasets, surveys, or proprietary data — the strongest AI citation signal.
findings.recommendation: Create at least one original data piece such as a travel cost survey.

findings.title: Month pages may have duplicate content risk
findings.description: 12 pages under /best-time-to-visit/[month] share a common template. If content is largely identical with only month names swapped, they risk thin content penalties.
findings.recommendation: Audit month pages for unique value — each should include month-specific festivals, weather data, and itinerary tips.

findings.title: RSS feed contains invalid fragment URLs
findings.description: Two RSS items link to /#itineraries/ and /#best-time/ — fragment URLs with trailing slashes that won't resolve in RSS readers. Also conflicts with trailingSlash: never policy.
findings.recommendation: Fix to proper page URLs: /itineraries and /best-time-to-visit.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All pages have unique, descriptive meta descriptions
Self-referencing canonical tags on every page
Proper heading hierarchy (H1→H2→H3) across all pages
Strong internal linking between related content
Descriptive anchor text in navigation and content links

findings.title: Title tags exceed SERP display limit on inner pages
findings.description: Destination page titles follow pattern 'CityName Travel Guide 2026: Best Attractions, Food, Hotels & Insider Tips | Yunnan Province Travel Guide' — ~118 chars vs 60 char SERP limit. The suffix pushes titles well past the display cutoff.
findings.recommendation: Shorten to 'CityName Travel Guide 2026' or drop the Yunnan Province Travel Guide suffix.

findings.title: OG image inconsistency across pages
findings.description: Mix of relative (/images/...) and absolute (https://yunnanprovince.com/images/...) URLs for og:image. 12 month pages use generic hero instead of dedicated og-best-time.webp.
findings.recommendation: Standardize to absolute URLs. Point month pages to og-best-time.webp.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: JSON-LD format used throughout (Google's preferred format)
Homepage has Organization + @graph with Article, TouristDestination, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage
Destination pages have complete schema with Article, TouristDestination, and BreadcrumbList
TouristDestination schema includes touristType array and containedInPlace
Structurally valid JSON-LD across all pages

findings.title: Logo field uses favicon.svg
findings.description: Organization schema uses favicon.svg as logo — Google requires minimum 112×112px for logo rich results.
findings.recommendation: Create a proper logo image (PNG/WebP, 112×112px+) and reference it.

findings.title: FAQPage rich results retired
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on May 7, 2026. Markup still aids AI parsing but won't produce SERP features. No action needed.
findings.recommendation: Keep markup for AI citation purposes. No change required.

findings.title: Missing WebSite schema with SearchAction
findings.description: No WebSite schema present, which enables the Sitelinks Search Box in SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Add WebSite schema with SearchAction to base layout.

findings.title: Missing Person schema for authors
findings.description: Article schema uses 'Yunnan Guide Team' — a generic byline. Individual Person schema with url, sameAs, and jobTitle would strengthen E-E-A-T.
findings.recommendation: Add Person schema for individual authors when bylines are implemented.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CSS and JS properly bundled (single CSS file, single JS file)
Hero images use loading='eager', gallery images use loading='lazy'
Google Fonts use preconnect for faster loading
No heavy third-party scripts (no GA4, no chat widget — ironically helps perf)

findings.title: Multiple images exceed 300 KB
findings.description: 7 images exceed 300 KB (xishuangbanna-rainforest.webp at 492 KB is worst). For hero-dimension WebP images, 150-200 KB should be the target.
findings.recommendation: Run all images through compression targeting 80-85% quality WebP at <200 KB.

findings.title: No fetchpriority='high' on hero LCP image
findings.description: Hero images (the LCP element) don't use fetchpriority='high' to signal priority loading to the browser.
findings.recommendation: Add fetchpriority='high' to hero img tags.

findings.title: Google Fonts loaded externally
findings.description: Geist and Fraunces fonts loaded from fonts.googleapis.com — adds ~50 KB transfer and external DNS dependency.
findings.recommendation: Consider self-hosting fonts for faster LCP and reduced external dependencies.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt present with well-structured page hierarchy
AI crawlers allowed (GPTBot, anthropic-ai, CCBot, PerplexityBot)
Fully server-rendered content — AI crawlers can read everything
Question-based H2s for extractable answer passages
FAQ section with clean Q&A format
Content updated August 2026 — within 3-month AI citation recency window

findings.title: No first-party data or unique statistics
findings.description: The strongest GEO signal is unique, proprietary data. Zero original research exists — all content is curated/compiled.
findings.recommendation: Create at least one original data piece (cost survey, altitude guide, transport comparison).

findings.title: Missing ClaudeBot and OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt
findings.description: PerplexityBot is explicitly allowed but OAI-SearchBot (OpenAI search) and ClaudeBot (Anthropic web) are not — missing the two most important AI search crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit Allow directives for OAI-SearchBot and ClaudeBot.

findings.title: No multi-modal content
findings.description: Content with video, interactive tools, or calculators sees 156% higher AI citation rates. Site is text + images only.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one interactive element — destination quiz or budget calculator.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images in WebP format
Proper lazy loading on below-fold images
Custom OG images for main content categories
Responsive styling with object-cover

findings.title: Gallery alt text is non-descriptive across all pages
findings.description: Every gallery image on every page has alt text like 'Kunming - photo 1', 'Dali - photo 2' — completely useless for accessibility and SEO. This pattern repeats across all 6 destination pages.
findings.recommendation: Replace with descriptive alt text naming what each image actually shows.

findings.title: Hero image alt text too generic
findings.description: Hero images only show city name ('Kunming, Yunnan Province') instead of describing the scene.
findings.recommendation: Add scene descriptions to hero alt text.

findings.title: OG images inconsistent
findings.description: Mix of relative and absolute URLs. 12 month pages use generic hero-yunnan.webp instead of dedicated og-best-time.webp.
findings.recommendation: Standardize to absolute URLs. Fix month page OG images.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Deploy static build from dist/ to live server
Install GA4 tracking with actual gtag.js snippet
Sync robots.txt (deploy dist version)
Add HSTS and CSP security headers
Fix gallery alt text across all destination pages

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Standardize OG images to absolute URLs, fix month pages
Add fetchpriority='high' to hero LCP images
Fix RSS feed fragment URLs and trailing slashes
Compress oversize images to <200 KB
Shorten destination page titles
Add OAI-SearchBot and ClaudeBot to robots.txt

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add individual author bylines with Person schema
Create at least one original research/data piece
Add WebSite + SearchAction schema
Add ImageObject schema to hero images
Build Wikipedia/Wikidata or social presence
Add sameAs links to Organization schema

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Implement IndexNow protocol
Set up Google Search Console, submit sitemap
Monitor GA4 organic traffic and search performance
Audit month page uniqueness
Consider self-hosting Google Fonts
Add unique sitemap lastmod dates
